app.name: Gekko2 SPEED BETA12.24a FULLSCREEN TRACE
app.version: BETA12.24a - full output, bounded game diagnostics
app.long_description: Experimental PS2 game diagnostic build. Bounded GIF/XGKICK/SIGNAL, VIF and interrupt history, unknown VU pairs and CPU wait context in numbered SD session logs. Restores full output size; removes automatic 4:3 pillarboxing. Retains transport/UV diagnostics and corrections. Both experiments factory OFF; saved settings apply at Cold Boot. No confirmed Crash/Tekken gameplay or SIGNAL stall resolution. Keep BETA12.23 for rollback. Bring your own legal BIOS/disc.
